prompt:
Build a 2 s closed-loop active-suspension quarter-car model in Simulink. The mechanical plant must include a sprung body mass, an unsprung wheel mass, a suspension spring and damper between them, tyre compliance to the moving road, and an active force actuator acting between the body and wheel. A feedback controller must use measured suspension and body motion to command the actuator. The applied actuator force must feed the same mechanical path that produces body acceleration and suspension deflection; prescribed output histories, disconnected control paths, or replayed trajectories are not valid.

Read xauto11_input from the MATLAB base workspace.

The xauto11_input struct contains finite real scalar fields sprung_mass_kg in [100, 300] kg, suspension_stiffness_n_per_m in [12800, 19200] N/m, suspension_damping_n_s_per_m in [700, 1300] N*s/m, road_peak_m in [0.04, 0.07] m, and road_angular_frequency_rad_per_s in [8*pi, 12*pi] rad/s. Use its sprung mass, suspension stiffness, suspension damping, road peak, and road angular frequency in the connected plant and disturbance path. The road input must be a smooth finite-duration bump that begins and returns to zero within the 2 s run. The closed loop must remain finite and stable across the complete published ranges while balancing passenger comfort, tyre/suspension travel, and active control effort. Changes in sprung mass, suspension parameters, and road magnitude or frequency must materially affect the connected dynamic response.

Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named suspension_state and active_control_state. suspension_state has width 5 in this order: road displacement, body displacement, wheel displacement, and suspension deflection (m), followed by body acceleration (m/s^2). active_control_state has width 2 in this order: the controller's dimensionless normalized command and the applied active force (N). suspension_state must contain the actual connected road, body, wheel, suspension-deflection, and body-acceleration signals. active_control_state must contain the controller's dimensionless normalized command and the physical force in newtons actually applied to the mechanical plant after actuator dynamics and force scaling. Both logs must begin at 0 s, use a strictly increasing time axis, contain only finite values, and reach 2 s without truncation. Save the completed model as cand_XAUTO11.slx in the submission directory.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XAUTO11.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
